name: mouse
title: Mouse & Trackpad
description: A three-finger tap or click on the trackpad as a middle click, and scrolling reversed for the trackpad, the mouse or both, the vertical and horizontal axes apart (what MiddleClick and Scroll Reverser do). The switches are this extension's settings; the palette flips them.
author: pal

settings.label: Middle click
settings.text: A three-finger click on the trackpad is a middle click
settings.description: Three fingers resting on the trackpad as it is pressed: the click is a middle one. Needs Accessibility.

settings.label: Tap too
settings.text: A three-finger tap is a middle click too
settings.description: With Middle click on, three fingers tapped and lifted together, without moving, click the middle button at the cursor. Turn off System Settings > Trackpad > Look up with three fingers so the two do not fight.

settings.label: Reverse trackpad
settings.description: Scrolling with the trackpad goes the other way from System Settings' natural scrolling. Needs Accessibility.

settings.label: Reverse mouse
settings.description: Scrolling with a mouse wheel (or a Magic Mouse) goes the other way from System Settings' natural scrolling, which macOS otherwise applies to the mouse and the trackpad alike. Needs Accessibility.

settings.label: Vertical
settings.description: The reversed devices scroll the other way up and down.

settings.label: Horizontal
settings.description: The reversed devices scroll the other way left and right.

setting.description: middle_click, middle_click_tap, reverse_trackpad, reverse_mouse, reverse_vertical or reverse_horizontal

mouse.title: Mouse & Trackpad
mouse.description: The middle click and scroll reversal switches, flipped with Enter; the row that asks for Accessibility when it is missing.

store.tagline: Three-finger middle click and scroll reversal per device
features: A three-finger click on the trackpad is a middle click, its drag a middle drag; a three-finger tap (down and up together, not moved) clicks the middle button at the cursor
Scrolling reversed for the trackpad, the mouse or both, the vertical and horizontal axes apart: natural scrolling on the trackpad and a wheel that goes the old way, as Scroll Reverser does
Each switch a row: Enter flips it, `pal://mouse/toggle?setting=reverse_mouse` for a keybind
Fingers are read over macOS's MultitouchSupport, so a Magic Trackpad paired later and a wake are picked up again

actions.title: Flip
actions.description: The row's switch on or off.
